accepted_interpretation.interpretation: Source fact: reflecting the left vertical integral expresses it as a finite combination of absolutely convergent Dirichlet series times gamma-product ratios. Stirling splits each ratio into an oscillatory main term with phase t(10 log t+log y) and a separately bounded error; interval subdivision and a second-derivative estimate give a half-power saving in contour height for the main term. Interpretation: the functional equation does more than move the series into convergence—it exposes phase curvature that can be converted into cancellation.
